text: I applied for a housing subsidy in January and have not received a decision. My rent has increased and I need to know whether the subsidy will be granted before the next payment.
I received a tax assessment that lists income I did not earn in the previous year. I believe this is an error and would like it corrected.
I am writing about the building permit for the extension at the rear of my property. The inspector visited but I have heard nothing since.
Following our conversation last month, nothing has changed and I still have not had an answer. Please advise what happens next.
